memos.argument: The NxStage fluid warmer is an electro-medical apparatus for warming dialysis/IV fluid before infusion; heading 9018 covers other electro-medical apparatus and parts/accessories. CROSS H81049 classified an IV fluid/blood warmer in 9018.90.75, citing medical-use characteristics (single-use limits, contamination concern); 9018.90.75.20 is dialysis instruments and apparatus. Disposable sets, if dedicated accessories, follow in 9018 (N065317 put medical plastic tubing assemblies in 9018.90.75.80, though other tubing in 3917).
exclusions_against: Ch. 90 note 1(f) excludes parts of general use / similar goods of plastics (chapter 39) - could pull generic disposable tubing to 3917/3926
Chapter 90 note 1 exclusion list is long; none excludes electro-medical warmers per se
N065317 shows plain plastic tubing can fall in 3917 rather than 9018

memos.argument: The unit is an electrothermic heating appliance; 8516.79 'Other' electrothermic appliances. Argument is weak because 8516 covers appliances of a kind used for domestic purposes and ch. 85 is generally subordinate to specific medical heading 9018.
exclusions_against: 8516 text limited to domestic-type electrothermic appliances; this is professional medical equipment
Ch. 85 note 1(d) excludes medical vacuum apparatus to 9018, showing medical apparatus priority
H81049 put a comparable IV fluid warmer in 9018 not 8516
N026077 concerns ordinary electric heaters (space heaters), not medical

memos.argument: If the Warmer Disposable Sets are entered separately as plastic tubing/bag sets, 3926 other articles of plastics is the residual plastic heading. It cannot cover the electric warmer itself. Not verified that 3926.90.99 is the exact leaf; heading-level residual only.
exclusions_against: Ch. 39 note 2(u) excludes articles of chapter 90
Ch. 39 note 2(s) excludes articles of section XVI
Plastic tubing has a more specific heading 3917 ahead of 3926
Applies at most to separately entered disposables; description lists warmer and sets together
